description: Mars is the next frontier and the true start of the interplanetary space age—where every step demands tactical mapping of hazardous terrain, storm shelters, and off-world resources.
summary: Jezero Crater Survival Map & Telemetry HUD is an interactive navigation dashboard designed to guide astronauts during Marswalks in Jezero Crater (18.44°N, 77.45°E). It combines four NASA science data layers—Optical imagery, MOLA elevation/slope data, MRO CTX terrain imagery, and 3D oblique relief—across local (45 km crater) and regional zoom scales. Using real-time telemetry, the map flags safe landing zones (like the 4.2° Octavia E. Butler basin), steep cliff hazards, high-wind areas, mineral sampling sites, and extreme seasonal temperatures (-24°C to -98°C) to keep explorers safe.
details: Jezero Crater Survival Map & Telemetry HUD is an interactive navigation dashboard designed to guide astronauts during Marswalks in Jezero Crater (18.44°N, 77.45°E), near the Octavia E. Butler landing site. Using data from NASA Mars Trek, the HUD integrates four visual sensor modes—Optical natural color, MOLA DEM slope/elevation, MRO CTX high-resolution grayscale terrain, and 3D oblique relief—across local (45 km crater) and regional zoom scales. To maximize crew safety and scientific discovery, it highlights safe landing basins (4.2° slope), steep cliff hazards, high-wind areas, mineral sampling zonesand seasonal Martian temperatures (-24°C to -98°C).
